# Vozo AI

> > Vozo AI provides AI-powered video translation, dubbing, and editing tools with advanced lip sync technology and voice cloning capabilities.

Vozo AI offers a comprehensive suite of video localization products including Video Translator, Voice Studio, and Rewrite & Redub tools, alongside developer APIs (LipREAL, VoiceREAL, Face Swap, Talking Photo). The platform supports multilingual content creation for YouTube, TikTok, and other video platforms with AI dubbing, lip synchronization, and voice cloning technology.

## Key Topics

- Vozo Video Translator
- VoiceREAL (AI voice cloning)
- Vozo LipREAL (lip sync API)
- Voice Studio
- AI dubbing and video localization
- Multilingual video translation
- Lip synchronization technology
- Face swap and talking photo APIs
- Text-to-speech editing
- YouTube and TikTok video translation
- Video rewriting and redubbing
- Multi-speaker voice cloning
- API integration for developers
- Subtitle generation and localization

## Core Video Tools

- [AI Voice Studio | Edit Speech Like Text](https://www.vozo.ai/voice-studio): Voice Studio: text-based speech editor with cloning and rewriting
- [Traducteur de Vidéos avec IA – Gratuit et en Ligne](https://www.vozo.ai/fr/video-translator): French video translator: multilingual dubbing, lip sync, subtitles
- [AI视频二创](https://www.vozo.ai/zh/video-rewrite): Chinese video rewrite tool: AI script rewriting, dubbing, lip sync

## Language-Specific Translation

- [Translate French Video to English | Vozo Video Translator](https://www.vozo.ai/translate-french-video-to-english): French-to-English translator with VoiceREAL, lip sync, YouTube support
- [Translate English Video to Turkish | Vozo Video Translator](https://www.vozo.ai/translate-youtube-video-to-turkish): English-to-Turkish video translator with AI dubbing and auto-subtitles

## API Reference

- [AI Video API Suite｜Vozo AI](https://www.vozo.ai/api): API suite: lip sync, talking photo, face swap, translate & dub APIs
- [Suite d'API vidéo AI](https://www.vozo.ai/fr/api): French API docs: Vozo LipREAL, face swap, talking photo integration
